notes: Seed URL works. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The Elections page posts scanned Electionware 'Summary Results Report ... UNOFFICIAL RESULTS' files (county totals; Baylor has 4 precincts, 'Precincts Reporting 4 of 4'); no precinct-by-precinct report is posted for any target election. 2024 general summary printed 10:11 PM election night but uploaded Wed, 06 Nov 2024 17:20:30 GMT (11:20 AM CST next day). 2026 primary summary printed 7:59 PM and uploaded 8:26 PM CST on election night. The 2026 runoff has only a post-election hand count certification, no results file; check 3 pending for the runoff (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Scanned PDFs read visually (OCR text layer partly garbled).
tag_rationale: 2024 general and 2026 primary are both LATER (county totals only, no precinct numbers posted online), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence low because the 2024 file was uploaded after election night.
